fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2026-02-16, residents reported that a group gathered daily near Kalai Park Main Street in Thanjavur to play cards for money, causing disturbances. The time of the incident was given as 22:05 on 2026-02-16. Malathi Bai submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000495. A witness, Meena Sekar, reachable on 9000000196, was mentioned in the complaint. The complaint refers to another person whose identity could not be established. A yellow motorcycle with registration TN-33-YY-1094 was observed near Kalai Park Main Street. The complainant alleged that Karthik Rajan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000091. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Organised card game reportedly run late at night.
fields.Keywords: illegal gambling, card game, CCTV, motorcycle, photograph, witness, night, main street
